Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class StateScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.StateScenarios
final class StateScenarios extends Object
Bucket state, stack size, crafting remainder and furnace fuel scenarios shared by both loaders.

      In game: put sixteen empty Big Buckets, Huge Buckets, Source Buckets, Junk Buckets, Trash Buckets or Mob Buckets in one slot; a seventeenth starts a new stack.       static void loading_removes_malformed_content_and_keeps_unrelated_nbt(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Loading saved bucket state removes impossible content and keeps unrelated NBT. In game: a world where a Big Bucket's saved NBT was edited to hold zero milk, or more powder snow than it fits, loads the bucket as empty, with the removed state written to the log.
